meta.paper_title: Mechanistic Understanding of Large AI Models with SemanticLens

dimension_1_data_split_hygiene.justification: The SemanticLens pipeline reproduced here is fundamentally observational / training-free: per-component top-k reference inputs are screened by activation, embedded with a frozen OpenAI CLIP ViT-B/32 tower (scripts/common.py:228 `clip.load("ViT-B/32")`), pooled, and cosine-scored against frozen CLIP text embeddings. There is no fitted classifier, probe, or learned threshold that could leak test labels. The evaluation metrics are computed directly on the pooled vectors: purity (runs/M6_C1_last_layer/purity__k16__mean.json), MRR (runs/M8_C2_queryability/mrr__k16__mean.json), stability on disjoint image halves (runs/M9_C2_stability, an explicit within-component split), and between/within separation (runs/M10_C2_separation). Fixed evaluation criteria (tau_stable=0.5, Cohen's d>=0.5, McNemar/permutation baselines) are pre-specified, not tuned on held-out labels. The one heuristic 'threshold' — the 0.85 CLIP-text clustering used to define fc same-concept groups in M10 — is a grouping definition rather than a fitted decision boundary, and its threshold-sensitivity ({0.75..0.90}) is logged in the M10 JSON, so it is not a hidden selection knob. No fitting-vs-evaluation overlap path exists.

dimension_2_label_validity.justification: Ground truth differs by predicate. For P1a (fc last-layer purity), the 'true concept' of each fc component is its own ImageNet class identity, drawn from torchvision ResNet50_Weights.IMAGENET1K_V2.meta['categories'] (scripts/common.py:88), an independent, well-defined label; matching the CLIP-decoded top-1 concept to that class name (top1_purity=0.898 vs random 0.001, runs/M6_C1_last_layer/purity__k16__mean.json) is a valid operationalization of 'concept-faithful summary' for class-tied neurons. For P1b (hidden layer4/layer3), there is no independent human label for what a hidden neuron encodes; the metric is a self-referential top-1-vs-top-2 concept CLIP-cosine separation gap (runs/M7_C1_hidden/sep__k16__mean.json), and the concept vocabulary is a curated 'broden-STYLE' union of 1203 concepts, honestly disclosed as NOT the original Broden dataset (EXPERIMENT_RESULTS.md line 30). This is a reasonable but under-validated proxy — the gap measures internal discriminability, not agreement with an external ground truth, an inherent limitation of hidden-neuron interpretation rather than a fabricated label. Not circular in the disqualifying sense (labels are not generated by the model under test), but the hidden-layer construct is a proxy with a documented gap.

dimension_3_resource_fidelity.justification: The canonical task.md specifies ResNet-50 (ImageNet-pretrained) as the inspected model, ImageNet as the probe dataset, and CLIP image tower (default) as the frozen foundation encoder. The run honors all three exactly: ResNet-50 loaded as torchvision IMAGENET1K_V2 (scripts/common.py:240), full ImageNet-1k validation split at used_n=50000/50000=100% (EXPERIMENT_RESULTS.md 'Data Actually Used' table; runs/M12 log '50000/50000 images'), and OpenAI CLIP ViT-B/32 as the default foundation encoder (runs/M0_setup/env.json clip='openai-git'; common.py:228). No model or dataset was silently downgraded or subsetted in the main experiment; component counts are large (1000 fc, 500+500 hidden, 2000 for stability). The verify-stage candidates named in task.md (ViT-B/16, VGG-16, EfficientNet-B0) were actually executed as M12 (real logs logs/m12_*.log and JSONs runs/M12_cross_model_verify/*.json) before being set aside by an explicit mid-run user directive (EXPERIMENT_RESULTS.md user_overrides.skip_M12), which is a documented scope decision, not a resource downgrade. Baseline resource fidelity is exact.

dimension_4_evidence_sufficiency.justification: Every predicate rests on large-scale evaluation, well above any thin-data concern. P1a: 1000 fc components x 1000 class-name text queries (runs/M6). P1b: 500 layer4 + 500 layer3 components (runs/M7). P2a: 1000 components x 1000 text queries, MRR=0.898 (runs/M8, n_queries=1000, n_components=1000). P2b: 2000 components x 32 images (runs/M9, n_components=2000). P2c: 10000 random cross-pairs per pool (runs/M10, n_between=10000, n_within=118983 for fc). No conclusion is asserted without a run behind it. The only genuinely limited-coverage dimension is architectural breadth: the universality clause 'for every component c in a trained vision model' is evidenced on a single architecture (ResNet-50), because the cross-model M12 runs were set aside by user directive — but this is honestly flagged as a scope limitation in CLAIMS_LEDGER.md and the claim was narrowed to 'ResNet-50/ImageNet-scoped' rather than overclaimed. Claim strength matches evidence strength on the tested scope.

dimension_5_statistical_rigor.justification: Uncertainty is reported broadly: McNemar paired p-values for purity (p=1.89e-270, runs/M6), bootstrap 95% CIs and paired one-sided t-test p-values for the hidden matched-control gap (layer4 Delta_sep=0.02015, CI [0.01841,0.02190], p~0, runs/M7), a 1000-sample permutation baseline for MRR (perm95_upper=0.0097 vs MRR=0.898, runs/M8), CIs on stability (0.970, CI [0.969,0.971], runs/M9), and Cohen's d with p-values for separation (layer4 d=1.96, p=0.0, runs/M10). A k-sweep {1,4,16,64,256} and a four-way pooling ablation {mean, act_weighted_mean, max, medoid} act as additional robustness axes, plus a 'random' reference-set baseline (runs/M4_v_c/v_c__*__random.h5). The claimed effects (Delta=0.897 purity, d=1.96 separation) vastly exceed noise. The one gap is that repeated random seeds for the reference-input sampling itself are not reported as a seed sweep — variance is characterized via CIs/permutation rather than multi-seed reruns — so seed-level robustness of the sampling step is inferred rather than measured. Strong overall, minor single-seed caveat.

dimension_6_causal_claim_validity.justification: n/a — no causal/mechanistic-intervention claim. Both C1 and C2 are observational mapping claims (component -> reference examples -> pooled CLIP vector), matching SemanticLens's own observational design (paper Sec. 3.1-3.2, Eq. 1-2: E_k = top_m activating samples, theta_k = mean over F(x)). The run itself labels the method observational throughout: verify/C2_clip_joint_semantic_space/variant_audit/MECHANISM_AUDIT.json overall_verdict='n/a' with note 'CRP-compose is an observational method ... no mechanism intervention (no steering, no CAA, no activation patching)', and VERIFY_REPORT.md records 'Mechanism audit overall_verdict: N/A (observational)'. No causal wording is applied to correlational evidence; the claims stay at the level of 'faithful summary' and 'placement in semantic space', which are correctly framed as descriptive, not interventional.

dimension_7_result_provenance.justification: Every headline number traces to a specific on-disk JSON product and agrees exactly. P1a top1_purity=0.898 / random=0.001 / p=1.8928834978668395e-270 appears identically in runs/M6_C1_last_layer/purity__k16__mean.json and is copied verbatim into runs/M13_final_report/results_table.json and EXPERIMENT_RESULTS.md. P1b layer4 Delta_sep=0.02015438862144947 with CI [0.01841,0.02190] matches runs/M7_C1_hidden/sep__k16__mean.json. P2a MRR=0.8982967484500607, R@10=0.974, perm95=0.0097 matches runs/M8_C2_queryability/mrr__k16__mean.json. P2b stability median=0.9703419 matches runs/M9. P2c layer4 gap=0.16990679, d=1.9585 matches runs/M10_C2_separation/sep__k16__mean.json. Even the 'retracted' P3 numbers are real, not fabricated: FINAL_RESULTS.md vit_b_16 MRR=0.8940 matches runs/M12_cross_model_verify/vit_b_16__k16__mean.json (mrr=0.8940130), backed by real run logs (logs/m12_vit_b_16.log). Cost/runtime records exist (runs/A1_full_pipeline/cost.json). No sourceless or back-filled value was found.

dimension_8_cross_artifact_consistency.justification: The core C1/C2 numbers and verdicts are consistent across EXPERIMENT_RESULTS.md, runs/M13_final_report/results_table.json, CLAIMS_LEDGER.md, and verify/VERIFY_REPORT.md: C1 = supported-but-partial/INTEGRITY_ONLY (P1c strict monotone plateau fails, honestly propagated as passes_P1c=false everywhere), C2 = supported / verify PASS robustness=1.0. Integrity states (Phase2=WARN, Phase9=WARN, INTEGRITY_ONLY cap reason) are propagated coherently. One genuine bookkeeping inconsistency: runs/M13_final_report/FINAL_RESULTS.md still renders the 'P3 — Cross-model transfer' table (efficientnet 0.8979, vgg16 0.8626, vit_b_16 0.8940) with 'Soft-pass (3/3): True', whereas EXPERIMENT_RESULTS.md (user_overrides.skip_M12) and CLAIMS_LEDGER.md declare P3 SKIPPED/RETRACTED and state M13 aggregation was 'retained for M0-M11 only'. So one artifact (M13 FINAL_RESULTS.md) was not regenerated after the skip and displays a run-status that the ledger contradicts. This is a stale, unpropagated flag rather than a metric conflict that flips a verdict — the P3 numbers are real and, if anything, would only strengthen the claims, so no PASS is being falsely manufactured — but it is a clear self-inconsistency about run status between artifacts.

C1.claim: For every component c in a trained vision model, a small set of reference inputs that strongly drive c is a concept-faithful summary of what c encodes.

method.justification: 9a — The chosen method is exactly SemanticLens's first mapping (paper Eq. 1: E_k,l = {CRP(x): x in top_m(M_k^l, D)}), operationalized via CLIP-Dissect: per-component top-k maximally-activating ImageNet reference inputs, then CLIP embedding and cosine scoring against a concept text vocabulary (scripts/m2_reference_sets.py, m6_c1_last_layer.py, m7_c1_hidden.py). This correctly matches the 'concept-faithful summary' mechanism category the claim is about, and CLIP-Dissect (Oikarinen & Weng 2023) is the literature-supported instantiation the paper itself cites. The interpretive assumption (maximally-activating examples reveal the encoded concept) is the standard, well-founded one for this claim type. Method is aptly matched.

experiment.justification: 9b — Design is layered and largely sound: P1a fc top-1 purity vs a random-input baseline with McNemar significance (runs/M6, 1000 components), P1b hidden layer4/layer3 matched-control (top-1 vs top-2 concept) separation gap with bootstrap CIs and t-tests (runs/M7, 500+500), and a P1c k-sweep {1,4,16,64,256} probing the 'small set' clause. Baselines, significance testing, and multi-layer coverage are present and well-powered. Weaknesses: (i) fc purity is a comparatively easy test since fc neurons are class-tied; (ii) P1b uses a self-referential top-1-vs-top-2 gap with no independent hidden-neuron ground truth; (iii) the P1c 'plateau' pass-criterion (monotone-nondecreasing) genuinely failed (passes_P1c=false, runs/M13/results_table.json) and the report proposes relaxing it to 'plateau within k<=16' — a post-hoc criterion softening, though it is transparently disclosed, not silently applied, and the underlying curve is shown; (iv) the universality clause was tested on only one architecture because M12 was set aside by user directive. Honest and mostly complete, with a couple of design gaps and one openly-flagged post-hoc criterion restatement.

result.justification: 9c — Result analysis is reasonable and qualitatively agrees with the paper's premise that a component's maximally-activating reference set faithfully summarizes its concept: fc top-1 purity 0.898 vs 0.001 random (Delta=0.897, p~0) and significant positive hidden-layer separation (layer4 Delta_sep=0.020, layer3 0.005, both p~0). The report does NOT overclaim: it marks C1 'partial / INTEGRITY_ONLY', discloses the P1c strict-plateau failure and the k=64/256 decline, and narrows the universality clause to ResNet-50/ImageNet in the ledger. This is an honest, appropriately-caveated reproduction with one disclosed sub-result deviation (P1c) rather than a forced pass or fabricated agreement.

C2.claim: Embedding those reference inputs with a frozen multi-modal foundation model and pooling the embeddings yields a single vector v_c placing c in the foundation model's joint image-text semantic space.

method.justification: 9a — This is a direct implementation of SemanticLens's second mapping (paper Eq. 2: theta_k = E_{x~E_k}[F(x)] approx (1/|E_k|) sum F(x)): pool frozen CLIP image-tower embeddings of the top-k reference inputs into a single v_c (scripts/m4_pool_vc.py), then cosine-score against CLIP text embeddings for text-queryability (scripts/m8_c2_queryability.py). The mean-pool default matches the paper's stated preference, and the run additionally ablates {mean, act_weighted_mean, max, medoid}. Method choice correctly matches the claim's 'placement in joint image-text semantic space' mechanism.

experiment.justification: 9b — Strong, multi-facet design: P2a text-query MRR/R@10 vs a 1000-sample permutation baseline (runs/M8), P2b disjoint-half within-component stability (runs/M9, 2000 components), P2c within-vs-between-concept separation with Cohen's d (runs/M10, 10000 pairs), a four-way pooling ablation (P2d), and a genuine method-swap verify variant (CRP-compose) that passed at robustness=1.0 (VERIFY_REPORT.md). Metrics correspond tightly to 'text-queryable joint semantic space.' The main design weakness is P2c on fc: the 'same-concept' grouping via CLIP-text-neighbor clustering at threshold 0.85 yields a near-zero gap (d=-0.015, runs/M10), which the report reframes post-hoc as a 'grouping-heuristic artifact' and pivots to the layer4 result (d=1.96) as the 'strong test.' The threshold-sensitivity is logged and the pivot to a more principled grouping (top-1 concept identity) is defensible, but it is a post-hoc reframing of a failing sub-metric. Otherwise complete and well-controlled.

result.justification: 9c — Results strongly and qualitatively agree with the paper's core claim that pooled reference-set embeddings place components in CLIP's text-searchable joint space: MRR=0.898 / R@10=0.974 vs permutation 0.0097, disjoint-half stability 0.970, and layer4 within-vs-between separation gap 0.170 with Cohen's d=1.96 (p~0) — directly reproducing SemanticLens's 'search for neurons of concept X' capability. The result survived an independent method swap (CRP-compose, MRR=0.9024, PASS). The one failing sub-result (fc P2c) is honestly bracketed as inconclusive-under-heuristic rather than hidden or fabricated, and the claim is scoped to ResNet-50/ImageNet. Verdict is a genuine, well-supported reproduction, not goalpost-tuned.
